description: Get a tax rule in full: statutory citation with its verbatim excerpt, validity window, parameters, the formula and applicability guard (the rule IR — rules are data), the rules and facts it depends on, and its content hash. Use to quote and explain the actual law behind an answer. Pass asOf to see only the version in force on that date.

asOf.description: ISO date; when given, only the version valid on that date is returned (omit for every version)

ruleId.description: e.g. "us.federal.standard_deduction" — list via calculate_tax proof, search_tax_rules, or the corpus

name: explain_rule
